title: VHL expiry
description: Restates IHE VHL ITI-YY4 Provide VHL. IHE VHL ITI-YY4 Provide VHL: “Check the payload's exp (if present) - reject if current time > expiration”.

statements.label: VHL expiry
statements.requirement: Validating a VHL payload against a caller-supplied now SHALL report an expired link when the payload's exp has passed, in addition to the HCERT exp check made by the verifier.
